newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Kinshasa death toll 200 -- Red Cross says.
newsitem.headline: Kinshasa death toll 200 -- Red Cross says.

text.p: At least 200 people were killed in various incidents in Zaire's capital Kinshasa at the week-end as Laurent Kabila's rebels took control of the city, the local Red Cross said on Sunday.
A Red Cross communique, issued the day after the rebels entered the city, said the figure was provisional.

"By 4 p.m. (on Sunday) 200 bodies were found. More than 60 were brought to various morgues in the city, 140 buried on the spot," the statement said, adding that a dozen wounded had been taken to hospitals and clinics.
Many of the dead were members of Mobutu's humiliated army, shot down by the rebel forces while looting.
About 200 Red Cross volunteers combed the streets of the sprawling capital of five million people, collecting bodies.

Medical workers predicted that the final figure would be much higher. "The figure released by the Red Cross is far below the reality. The 200 volunteers could not collect all the bodies in a single day," a nurse at Kinshasa's Mama Yemo hospital said.
